description: Use when the user is selling a large or valuable item (fitness equipment, hot tubs, saunas, golf carts, furniture, appliances), including when also posting to Facebook Marketplace, Craigslist, or OfferUp. The price the seller asked for on Facebook Marketplace, Craigslist, or OfferUp becomes their take-home on Commonplace. The buyer price includes pickup and delivery. Give category and price. price_type defaults to take_home. Pass facebook_buyer_price when the number is what a buyer pays on the other site. ZIP is optional. The result is take_home_usd and buyer_price_usd.

category.description: A category slug, a category name, or the item words.

price_type.description: take_home (the default) is what the seller takes home. facebook_buyer_price is what a buyer pays on the other site.
